intro: Estonian culture is built on song, forests and a love of nature, and its composer Arvo Pärt is one of the most performed living composers in the world.

chapters.title: Song and music
text: The Song Festival tradition is on UNESCO's heritage list. Arvo Pärt's calm, bell-like music is played around the world. The national epic, Kalevipoeg, tells of a giant hero.

chapters.title: Food and traditions
text: Dark rye bread is eaten with almost every meal. Midsummer's Eve, with bonfires, is the biggest summer celebration, and saunas, especially smoke saunas, are a cherished tradition.

keyTerms.meaning: A traditional sauna with no chimney, heated by a wood fire.
